summary: FERC gives the third supplemental notice of its October 21, 2026 Reliability Technical Conference in AD26-8. It lists pending dockets, including all six large-load show cause dockets, whose merits will not be discussed, and attaches an agenda with a large-load panel.

points.point: The conference is set for October 21, 2026, in person at FERC headquarters, on bulk-power reliability and security.
points.quote: will convene its annual Commissioner-led Reliability Technical Conference, in the above-referenced proceeding, on Wednesday, October 21, 2026, from 10:00 am to 2:40 pm Eastern Daylight Time

points.point: Discussion may touch pending proceedings, but merits discussion will be curtailed.
points.quote: some discussions may involve issues raised in proceedings that are currently pending before the Commission.  Any discussion on the merits of such proceedings will be curtailed.

points.point: The notice lists the show cause dockets for each region and PJM dockets ER26-3380 and ER26-3515 among the pending matters, starting with PJM's EL26-67.
points.quote: PJM Interconnection, L.L.C. Docket Nos. EL26-67-000 EL26-67-001

points.point: Panel 1 asks how entities should model and plan for rapidly emerging large loads such as data centers.
points.quote: How should entities model and plan for the rapid emergence of large, energy-intensive loads, such as data centers and AI compute campuses

points.point: Panel 1 speakers include a PJM operations planning director.
points.quote: Christopher Pilong, Sr. Director, Operations Planning, PJM Interconnection

throughLine.text: Schedules a reliability conference whose first panel covers large load integration and which lists the EL26-67 to EL26-72 show cause dockets as pending matters not to be argued on the merits.
